title: Holehe Email OSINT Output
description: Discovered accounts registered to a target email address across 120+ websites. Records are pushed individually per platform where the email is registered, plus one summary record with aggregate counts.

discoveredAccounts.title: Discovered Accounts
discoveredAccounts.description: One record per platform where the email is registered. Each record contains: `email`, `platform`, `category` (social/work/finance/etc.), `domain`, `emailrecovery` (partial recovery email hint if available), `phoneNumber` (partial phone hint if available), and `others` (platform-specific metadata). The final item is always a `summary` record with counts of accountsFound, totalChecked, rateLimited, and a list of platforms where the email was found.
